scenes.title: Planet (Earth)
scenes.blurb: A procedural Earth-like world from orbit — displaced continents, depth-tinted oceans and polar ice on a spinning cube-sphere, under a fixed sun.

scenes.title: Planet (Mars)
scenes.blurb: A dry, cratered red world — Tharsis-scale relief and no oceans, a different preset of the same procedural planet generator.

scenes.title: Planet (Moon)
scenes.blurb: An airless, heavily-cratered grey body — the same generator with craters turned up and the sea turned off.

scenes.title: Gas Giant
scenes.blurb: A banded gas giant — turbulent belts and zones with vortex storms, generated from domain-warped noise and baked to vertex colour.

scenes.title: Planet Lab
scenes.blurb: Design your own world — a live editor panel of sliders for the rocky and gas-giant generators. Tweak and hit Generate.

scenes.title: Agent Lab
scenes.blurb: A theta circuit where cognition-loop agents drive and walk, debug HUD on.
